data.narrative:
Duranium is a Pre-Seed stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Berkley Noble and Brenden Prins-McKinney, with $2M+ raised to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression analysis proves the only applicable triangulation method. Using the $2M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $5M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—while 8 Climate & Energy peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier required for meaningful median derivation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $4M to $6M, with a central estimate of $5M. This range reflects moderate upside and downside from the stage-progression baseline. Key uncertainties include the composition of the $2M raised (seed vs. founder capital), the absence of revenue or technology milestones, and limited peer data at this earliest stage. A peer-median approach may become viable upon identification of additional Pre-Seed or Seed-stage Climate & Energy companies with disclosed valuations.
